what: Midpoint slab products of the fixed-phase profile of Fig. 2 of the CPC paper, at 50 decimal digits.  Richardson-extrapolated three times, they are the reference the truncation-order curves are measured against; the extrapolation is converged well past 1e-18, so no part of that panel is the reference rather than the method.  Regenerated automatically when the fingerprint below stops matching the configuration.
